finish_audit.note: 本审计只读取本轮实际状态；它不补做检查、不发请求、不调用模型，也不会把缺失的完成标志补成成功。

next_action.why: 1 station(s) carry measurable band data, so the asked band question is answerable for the reviewed set (stations not acquired remain unknown)

limitations: Scope covered is only the single named station CHIMA (cf3bfe63e905); no whole-network conclusion is claimed, and no new acquisition was permitted this round.

The user-specified diagnostic grid this round was [[3,12]] Hz, but it did not yield a usable stability result: only 1 of 13 grid configurations produced an onset (4 Z-component STA/LTA configurations gave no pick, 0 errored, 0 not applicable), so the tool reports insufficient_configurations and the single onset (2.53 s) cannot be treated as confirmed or reproducible.
No STA/LTA onset in the 1-8 Hz method band was computed this round (onsets_computed = 0), so no 1-12 Hz pick reliability is established.

Band support itself passes: CHIMA is 100 Hz (Nyquist 50 Hz >= required 24 Hz) and three components Z/N/E exist, are mutually aligned, and cover the full 10:00:00-10:02:00 window; no channel-integrity flag was raised. Applicability is limited by the failure of the reproducibility diagnostic, not by sampling rate or component presence.
The requested 1-12 Hz band is not rewritten by the 3-12 Hz diagnostic grid; the grid actually run is reported as 3-12 Hz.
